references.label: Sword ramp
references.description: The right ramp collects Two Towers locks and starts the multiball on the final lock.
references.context: Lock three balls on the Sword ramp.

references.label: Center Ring
references.description: The center Ring selects and starts Ring modes and is central to Destroy the Ring.
references.context: Select a mode at the center Ring.

references.label: Gollum's Cave
references.description: The cave starts Gollum Multiball and collects several lit awards.
references.context: Start Gollum Multiball at Gollum's Cave.

references.label: Palantir target
references.description: The Palantir target gives a context-dependent award during movie multiballs.
references.context: Collect the lit Palantir during a movie multiball.

references.label: Barad-Dur
references.description: The tower shot starts Fellowship Multiball after all nine members are collected.

references.label: Orthanc tower
references.description: The tower is used by War of the Ents and can start Return of the King when lit.
references.context: Shoot Orthanc during War of the Ents.
